per_question.answer: Confabulation “Confabulation” refers to a phenomenon in which GAI systems generate and confidently present erroneous or false content in response to prompts [S1]. 9 Confabulations of falsehoods are most commonly a problem for text-based outputs; for audio, image, or video content, creative generation of non-factual content can be a desired behavior [S2]. Risks from confabulations may arise when users believe false content – often due to the confident nature of the response – leading users to act upon or promote the false information [S4].
